PageSubtitle: Configure your study programme and preferences
AutoSwitchDesc: Automatically enter Focus mode when a study session starts.
CourseSelectionDesc: Select your current courses. Click once for active, again for completed, again for inactive.
NotifBlockedMessage: 🚫 Notifications have been blocked. Please allow them in Safari's settings for this site and reload the page.
NotifIosMessage: 📲 Notifications only work on iOS if StudyLife has been added to the home screen. In Safari, tap Share → Add to Home Screen, open the app from the home screen, then come back here.
NotifUnsupportedMessage: ⚠️ Your browser doesn't support notifications. Please use Safari or a modern desktop browser.
NotifDefaultMessage: Allow notifications so StudyLife can remind you about study sessions.
CalendarSubscriptionDesc: Add this URL as a calendar subscription in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or similar, to view all scheduled study sessions externally (updates automatically).
CompletionNotePlaceholder: What did you take away from it? How did the exam go?
RemindersDesc: Fine-tune when StudyLife sends you push reminders. Comma-separated values, from largest to smallest.
InactivityThresholdDaysLabel: Nudge me after this many days without a session
NotificationTogglesDesc: Turn individual push notification categories on or off. Only applies once you've allowed notifications below.
StudyWindowDesc: Defines which hours and days the exam planner and weekly plan assistant are allowed to propose sessions in.
GraduationGoalDesc: Set your target graduation date — the dashboard shows how many study hours per week you need to reach it. Leave empty to disable.
TimerModesDesc: Create your own focus rhythms — they appear on the Focus page alongside the built-in modes.
BackupDesc: Download a consistent copy of your database, or export your data as JSON. A backup is also created automatically every week and the last 4 are kept.
RestoreDesc: Upload a database backup (.db file) you downloaded earlier to replace all current data. Only the database backup can be restored — not the JSON export.
RestoreConfirmWarning: This will replace ALL current StudyLife data with the contents of "{0}". Everything created or changed since that backup was made will be lost. A safety backup of the current database is saved on the server first.
RestoreStagedMessage: Backup verified and staged. Restart the StudyLife server to apply it (Docker: "docker restart studylife-server"). Until then the app keeps running on the current data.
RestorePendingBanner: A staged restore is waiting and will be applied at the next server restart.
RestoreRestartingMessage: The server is restarting to apply the restore. The app will be unavailable for a few seconds — then reload this page.
RestoreErrorInvalidFile: This file was rejected: it is not a valid, intact StudyLife database backup.
RestoreErrorUploadFailed: Upload failed. Please check your connection and try again.
BackupPasswordHint: Optional: encrypts the downloaded backup with this password (AES-256). Leave empty for an unencrypted download.
BackupEncryptedDownloadError: Encrypting or downloading the backup failed. Please check your connection and try again.
RestoreEncryptedPrompt: This backup is encrypted. Enter the password you used when downloading it.
WeeklyGoalDesc: Set how many hours per week you want to study — this value drives the weekly quota bar and the completion forecast. Default is 25-30h.
MonthlyGoalDesc: Set how many hours per month you want to study — this value drives the monthly quota bar, independently of your weekly goal. Default is 100-130h.
ProgramGroupsDesc: Optional: define elective groups with an ECTS cap — at most that many ECTS from each group count towards the degree, no matter how many of its courses you complete.
ProgramErrorGroupInvalid: Please enter a group name and an ECTS cap greater than 0.
ProgramErrorDuplicateGroup: A group with this name already exists.
ProgramErrorCreateFailed: Creating the programme failed. Please try again.
ProgramCompletedHint: You can switch back to this programme at any time to look back at its stats.
ConfirmDeleteProgramQuestion: Really delete this programme and all its courses?
HomeAssistantDesc: Generate a personal, long-lived API key for Home Assistant (and similar integrations). It never rotates and never expires — it stays valid until you regenerate or revoke it here. Treat it like a password.
HaKeyOnceHint: Copy the key now — it will not be shown again.
HaKeyRegenerateConfirmWarning: The current key becomes invalid immediately. Home Assistant's pairing will break until you enter the new key in the integration's settings.
HaKeyRevokeConfirmWarning: The key becomes invalid immediately. Home Assistant loses access until you generate a new key and enter it in the integration's settings.
AiIntegrationDesc: Generate a personal, long-lived API key for the studylife-ai assistant (and similar integrations). It never rotates and never expires — it stays valid until you regenerate or revoke it here. Treat it like a password.
AiKeyOnceHint: Copy the key now — it will not be shown again.
AiKeyRegenerateConfirmWarning: The current key becomes invalid immediately. studylife-ai loses access until you enter the new key in its configuration.
AiKeyRevokeConfirmWarning: The key becomes invalid immediately. studylife-ai loses access until you generate a new key and enter it in its configuration.
McpIntegrationDesc: Generate a personal, long-lived API key for the studylife-mcp server (Claude Desktop and other MCP clients). It never rotates and never expires — it stays valid until you regenerate or revoke it here. Treat it like a password.
McpKeyOnceHint: Copy the key now — it will not be shown again.
McpKeyRegenerateConfirmWarning: The current key becomes invalid immediately. studylife-mcp loses access until you enter the new key in its configuration.
McpKeyRevokeConfirmWarning: The key becomes invalid immediately. studylife-mcp loses access until you generate a new key and enter it in its configuration.
CalendarRegenerateConfirmWarning: This immediately invalidates the current calendar subscription URL. Any calendar app that already subscribed to it (Google, Apple, Outlook, …) will stop receiving updates — add the new URL there as a fresh subscription.
CourseResourcesErrorInvalidUrl: Please enter a valid http:// or https:// link.
ProgressShareDesc: Generate a public read-only link showing a compact snapshot of your progress (ECTS, average grade, active courses) — no login required. Good for sharing with parents, a mentor, or an academic advisor. No notes, sessions, or settings are ever exposed.
ProgressShareRegenerateConfirmWarning: This immediately invalidates the current progress link. Anyone who has the old link (parents, mentor, advisor) will no longer be able to view your progress — share the new link with them instead.
